lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Good Samaritan Law & Responsibilities at Crash Scenes
prompt: What specific information must motorists exchange following a vehicle crash in Texas?

options.text: Personal social security number, home mortgage papers, and tax returns
Digital passwords to personal cell phones and vehicle navigation memory
Complete employment medical records and blood laboratory test results
Operator name, address, vehicle registration, and liability insurance details
